verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hosted inference engine like vLLM, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage-stats collection, or any opt-out setting or environment variable. The CLI statistics printing and benchmark items are local performance reporting, not usage tracking, so they are not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
